conditions: Acceptable for adrenal crisis risk, unstable patient or initiation of complex therapy; not a documented source unit.

safety_opportunities.description: Recognize primary adrenal insufficiency and risk of adrenal crisis under stress.
Do not assume negative acid-fast stain excludes tuberculosis.
Antituberculous regimen in source is descriptive; independent guideline review is needed before rating as standard.
Before adrenal biopsy, assess hormonal activity and exclude pheochromocytoma; if the source does not report this, mark unknown rather than safe by default.
